items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: We got it from Maurice Durand, who just died last week on Thanksgiving Day.

ctx.x: Well, you have it at your shop, the big negative.

Yeah, I have it. I have it. I can make a credit. We got it from Maurice Durand, who just died last week on Thanksgiving Day. Oh, yeah. A carnet player. Used to live way downtown in Ninth Warden. He went to California. He died just last week. But he had a picture of the Peerless Band. It had Bab Frank on it, too. And on the drum was written, Frank and McCurdy or something, Peerless Band, 1906. But that date might have been put on the picture. I don't know. I don't think it was really on the drum. I think somebody…
Yeah. It might have been 1906. He was with the band around that.
